rationale: Tighten the t45 low-stock refs rule after v0016: an observed store_inventory row is not enough for a pure availability product ref when available_today_quantity is 0. Plain 'less than / fewer than N' count semantics may still treat NULL or 0 as below the threshold, but refs must cite only positively available products that pass the predicate (for low-stock: 0 < available_today_quantity < N). This preserves the v0016 NULL-ref fix and covers the 20260530-050756 failure where a zero-quantity Engelbert Strauss SKU was rejected as an invalid product reference. Analysis: .tasks/task-030/t45_analyze_gpt.md.

dependencies.why: Trusted date provider used when product count/update handling invokes policy_update_scan.
Actor identity pulled at session start (drives 'my' handling).
Public product facts, properties JSON, and the canonical catalogue record_path.
Per-SKU property rows (product_sku, property_key, property_value_*) used for claim verification.
Family/brand/model grouping used to identify products.
product_kind_id and product-kind scope for count questions.
Store/SKU availability source: available_today_quantity keyed by (store_id, product_sku).
Public store ids, record_path cite paths, city nuance targets, and open status.
Natural-language branch nuance used to choose between multiple stores in one city.

rollback.strategy: Revert to v0016 if the grader requires product refs for observed zero-quantity rows on pure availability counts, or if non-pure catalogue identity/match refs regress.
